beats.say: What if you ate one million chocolate bars… in just one week?
So you stay up all night, eating as fast as you can.
Your mouth turns brown… and your teeth start screaming.
By day two, you've eaten more sugar than most people eat in ten years.
You're so hyper, you run laps around the kitchen at 3 a.m.
Day four: just looking at chocolate makes you sick.
But the pile is still taller than your house.
Day seven. You take one last bite…
and an ambulance is already waiting outside.
Would you even make it to day two?
